children: Weak jobs data, high gas prices and crossborder trade friction haven't slowed down motor-vehicle sales in Canada, according to October data from DesRosiers Automotive Consultants. The firm reports car sales in October rose for a fifth straight month on a 12-month basis, up 1.8%. DesRosiers says the October performance is just shy of the sales posted in October of 2017 - or highest total on record for that particular month. On a seasonally-adjusted, annualized basis, sales in Canada jumped to just under 2 million, or the highest since February "and a true measure of market strength." The Bank of Canada raised its policy rate last week to 2.5%, in part due to surprising resilience among households, officials said. (paul.vieira@wsj.com; @paulvieira)
